name: Client Privacy Remediation and Retest
description: Walks through open remediation tasks, asks for resolution evidence and ends with a retest brief.
legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Steps marked as review are carried out by a person in the Target Profile screens; the automation does not perform them.

config.prompt: Open Target profile > Remediation. For each task record what was done and attach evidence. Mark a task resolved only after a retest.
